passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report. In addition to historical information, this discussion and analysis contains forward‑looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward‑looking statements as a result of certain factors. We discuss factors that we believe could cause or contribute to these differences below and elsewhere in this report, including those set forth under “Part I—Item 1A—Risk Factors” and under “Forward‑Looking Statements and Market Data” in this Annual Report. A discussion of the Company’s financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Non-GAAP Financial Measures We provide certain financial measures that are not defined under accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“GAAP”), commonly referred to as non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted Operating Expenses, Adjusted Income (Loss) from Operations, Adjusted Net Income (Loss), Adjusted Earnings Per Share, Free Cash Flow and certain other non-GAAP measures, each of which include adjustments to GAAP figures. These non-GAAP measures are intended to provide additional information on our operating performance. Adjustments to our GAAP figures exclude, as applicable, non-cash items such as share-based compensation, depreciation and amortization. Certain other special items or substantive events may also be included in the non-GAAP adjustments periodically when their magnitude is significant within the periods incurred. Non-GAAP adjustments are tax effected to the extent there is US GAAP current tax effect. The Company currently records a valuation allowance on its net deferred tax assets, so there is no net impact recorded for deferred tax effects in our tax expense. We maintain an established non-GAAP policy that guides the determination of what items may be excluded in non-GAAP financial measures. We believe that these non-GAAP measures, when considered together with the GAAP figures, can enhance an overall understanding of our operating performance. The non-GAAP financial measures are included with the intent of providing investors with a more complete understanding of our historical and expected financial results and trends and to facilitate comparisons between periods and with respect to projected information. In addition, these non-GAAP financial measures are among the indicators BeOne’s management uses for planning and forecasting purposes and measuring our performance. These non-GAAP financial measures should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, or superior to, GAAP financial measures. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: The following section includes material factors that we believe may adversely affect our business and operations. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below and all information contained in this Annual Report, including our financial statements and the related notes and “Part II-Item 7-Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” before deciding to invest in our ADSs, ordinary shares, or RMB Shares. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. In such an event, the market price of our ADSs, ordinary shares, and RMB Shares could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations. Please refer to the explanation of the qualifications and limitation on forward-looking statements set forth on page 1 hereof. 59 Table of Contents Summary of Risk Factors Below is a summary of the material factors that make an investment in our ADSs listed on Nasdaq, our ordinary shares listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, and our ordinary shares issued to permitted investors in China and listed and traded on the Science and Technology Innovation Board of the Shanghai Stock Exchange in Renminbi (“RMB Shares”) speculative or risky. This summary does not address all of the risks that we face. credit_strengths.text: The issuer turned profitable at the operating line in the latest year, reversing prior losses, with operating margin now positive and well above its own prior-year result. This earnings inflection underpins the improvement in coverage and cash generation, though the margin still trails the sector median, reflecting a commercial-stage pharmaceutical mix.

Gross leverage sits below the sector median, and the balance sheet is in a net cash position once cash is netted against interest-bearing debt. Liquidity is strong, with the current ratio well above both the prior year and the sector median, giving ample near-term buffer against working-capital swings.

key_risks.text: The risk factors flag that the issuer has limited experience launching and marketing internally developed and in-licensed medicines, and depends on achieving reimbursement and adequate pricing. Failure to build commercial capabilities or secure coverage would pressure product revenue and, in turn, the cash flow that currently services debt.

Debt is modest but split between long-term borrowings including current maturities and separately tagged short-term borrowings, so a portion falls due within the year. Refinancing that near-term piece depends on continued market access; the maturity schedule was not disclosed in the bundle, limiting visibility on the refinancing profile.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is comfortable and above the sector median, and improved sharply versus the prior year when operating income was negative. Operating income covers gross interest expense several times over, so debt service is not a binding constraint at current earnings, though the thin operating margin leaves less cushion if revenue softens.

Free cash flow after capital expenditure is strong relative to debt, and operating cash flow covers the debt stock more than once, both far above sector medians. Capital expenditure absorbs only a modest share of operating cash flow, leaving substantial internally generated funds available for debt service and reinvestment.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, driven by net cash exceeding debt and strong cash conversion. Gross leverage is below the sector median and interest coverage above it, while the operating margin remains below peers, so the credit story rests on cash generation rather than margin leadership. This is an analyst judgement, not a rating.

Shareholder return data was not disclosed, so whether distributions absorb free cash flow remains unknown and is a material gap for assessing discretionary cash use. Absent that, the balance sheet and cash flow support a stable outlook; the key monitorable is sustaining the earnings inflection against competitive and reimbursement pressure.

credit_strengths.text: 發行人於最近一年在經營層面轉虧為盈，扭轉先前虧損，經營利潤率現為正數，且遠高於其自身去年同期的結果。此盈利拐點支撐了覆蓋率及現金生成的改善，惟利潤率仍落後於行業中位數，反映其商業化階段製藥業務的組合特性。
總槓桿低於行業中位數，且將現金與計息債務對沖後，資產負債表處於淨現金狀況。流動性強勁，流動比率遠高於去年及行業中位數，為短期營運資金波動提供充裕緩衝。

key_risks.text: 風險因素指出，發行人在推出及營銷自主研發及授權引進藥物方面經驗有限，並依賴取得報銷及足夠定價。若未能建立商業化能力或取得覆蓋，將對產品收入構成壓力，進而影響目前用於償付債務的現金流。
債務規模不大，但分為長期借款（包括一年內到期部分）及另行標示的短期借款，故部分債務於年內到期。該短期部分的再融資取決於持續的市場准入；資料包未披露到期結構，限制了對再融資狀況的能見度。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率充裕且高於行業中位數，並較去年經營收入為負時大幅改善。經營收入對總利息支出的覆蓋達數倍，故按目前盈利水平，償債並非硬性約束，惟利潤率偏薄，若收入轉弱則緩衝較少。
扣除資本開支後的自由現金流相對於債務強勁，經營現金流對債務存量的覆蓋超過一倍，兩者均遠高於行業中位數。資本開支僅佔經營現金流的一小部分，留下大量內部生成資金可用於償債及再投資。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，主要由於淨現金超過債務及強勁的現金轉換。總槓桿低於行業中位數而利息覆蓋率則高於中位數，惟經營利潤率仍低於同業，故信用故事依賴現金生成而非利潤率領先。此為分析師判斷，並非評級。
股東回報數據未予披露，故分派是否吸納自由現金流仍屬未知，此為評估酌情現金運用的重大缺口。除此以外，資產負債表及現金流支持穩定展望；關鍵監察點為在競爭及報銷壓力下維持盈利拐點。
